mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate (2.2%) is below the historical average, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (GDPC1) is below 2.0% and unemployment (UNRATE) is above 4.0%, it indicates weakening economic conditions with labor market stress, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 2.0% and UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by a 3-month rise in FEDFUNDS above 2.5%), S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% (3-month rise), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is below 100 and FEDFUNDS is above 2.0%, it indicates a supply shock combined with tight monetary policy, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in CPIAUCSL above 255 (annualized inflation rate ~2.5%) signals high inflation, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 255, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200 thousand units and industrial production (INDPRO) is below 100, it indicates dual demand and supply shock, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1200 and INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
